name: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, Corporations Division: entity organization dates
reason: No free bulk data. 950 CMR 113.15 offers the full Corporations Information Management System extract only for purchase ($4,800/year or $100/week; file layout on request). The public search (corp.sec.state.ma.us) is per-entity and protected by bot detection (Incapsula), so it is not queried automatically.

name: Original issue dates for Massachusetts plumbing/gas-fitting and sheet-metal business licenses (DOL eLIPSE)
reason: Plumbers and Gas Fitters and Sheet Metal boards are on eLIPSE, which offers per-license lookups only. The MA Professional Licensing API requires a key issued to municipalities/vendors. The free OPSI facility export (madpl.mylicense.com) has no plumbing/HVAC business licenses.

name: OpenCorporates mirror of Massachusetts registry (us_ma)
reason: Requires an API token (HTTP 401 without one), and it is a third-party mirror rather than the SOC record.

name: Per-loan web page on data.sba.gov
reason: SBA publishes only bulk CSVs; loan evidence links point to the CSV plus the LoanNumber.
